PeakFit Fitness & Wellness Studio — Business & Pricing Information
About the Business
PeakFit Fitness & Wellness Studio is a premium fitness center offering gym memberships, personal
training, group classes, transformation programs, and wellness packages.
Customers can pay upfront, monthly, or through approved installment plans depending on the plan they
choose.
The assistant should use this information to explain charges, memberships, renewals, payment plans,
cancellations, and available services in simple customer-friendly language.
Membership Plans
1. Starter Plan — ₹1,999/month
The Starter Plan is designed for customers who want regular gym access without personal training.
Includes:
Unlimited gym access
Access to standard equipment
Locker access
Basic fitness assessment
One trainer orientation session
Billing: ₹1,999 every month.
Annual option: ₹19,999/year.
The annual plan saves ₹3,989 compared with paying ₹1,999 every month for 12 months.
2. Pro Fitness Plan — ₹3,499/month
The Pro Plan is designed for customers who want additional coaching and group classes.
Includes:
Unlimited gym access
Unlimited group fitness classes
Monthly fitness assessment
2 trainer-guided sessions per month

The Elite Plan provides a more personalized fitness experience.

Billing: ₹5,999 every month.

Personal Training Packages
4. Personal Training Starter — ₹7,999
Includes 5 personal training sessions.
Effective session price: ₹1,600 approximately.
Validity: 45 days from activation.
Payment is normally collected upfront.
5. Personal Training Plus — ₹14,499
Includes 10 personal training sessions.
Effective session price: approximately ₹1,450.

Transformation Programs
7. 30-Day Transformation Program — ₹8,999
A structured one-month fitness program.
Includes:
Initial fitness assessment
Personalized workout plan
4 trainer sessions
Weekly progress tracking
Basic nutrition plan
End-of-program assessment
Payment: ₹8,999 upfront.
8. 90-Day Transformation Program — ₹22,999
A three-month transformation program.
Includes:
Initial assessment
Personalized workout program
12 personal training sessions
Weekly progress tracking

Payment Plans & Installment Schemes
PeakFit may offer installment options for selected higher-value plans.
3-Month Split Plan
For eligible purchases above ₹15,000:
Example: ₹22,999 program
First payment: ₹7,667
Second payment: ₹7,666
Third payment: ₹7,666
The first payment is due at enrollment and subsequent payments are collected approximately every 30
days.
6-Month Split Plan
For eligible purchases above ₹30,000:
Example: ₹34,999 annual Pro membership
First payment: ₹6,000
Five subsequent payments: approximately ₹5,800 each
The exact amount shown to the customer should always come from the approved payment plan associated
with their case.
The assistant must not create a new installment schedule independently.
Promotional Schemes
PeakFit occasionally offers promotional pricing.

New Member Offer
New customers joining an eligible monthly membership may receive:
First month: 20% off
Examples:
Starter: ₹1,999 → ₹1,599
Pro: ₹3,499 → ₹2,799
Elite: ₹5,999 → ₹4,799
The discount applies only to the first billing cycle and does not permanently reduce the regular membership
price.
Annual Membership Offer
Customers choosing an annual membership receive a lower effective monthly cost compared with paying
month-to-month.
For example:
Starter Annual ₹19,999/year
instead of:
₹1,999 × 12 = ₹23,988
Pro Annual ₹34,999/year
instead of:
₹3,499 × 12 = ₹41,988
Elite Annual ₹59,999/year
instead of:
₹5,999 × 12 = ₹71,988
Annual memberships are paid according to the payment method and plan selected by the customer.
5
Referral Scheme
An existing customer who successfully refers a new customer may receive a ₹500 PeakFit credit after the
referred customer completes their first successful payment.
Referral credit can be used against eligible future purchases.
Referral credits cannot automatically be converted into cash.
